summary: CI for the anvil repo: backend pytest + frontend tests on every PR
epic_summary: WS-F Quality gates (Actions build+test on SIS, CodeQL, SonarCloud, SBOM, OSV, Dependabot)
description:
Due 2026-11-03. AGENTS.md says "merge after APPROVE and green CI", but the anvil repo has no PR CI, so reviewers run every suite by hand (4-8 min each).

## Do

* `.github/workflows/ci.yml` on pull_request + push to main: backend job (`uv sync`, `uv run python -m pytest`) with a Postgres+pgvector service container for the DB-backed tests and Docker available for the sandbox integration tests (ubuntu-latest has Docker; tests use small public images); frontend job (`npm ci && npm test`) when `frontend/package.json` exists.
* Tests needing the live gateway/Jira/GitHub stay opt-in (env flags), never in CI.
* Cache uv and npm.
* Required status check on main if the plan allows (private repo: may not; then document).

## Acceptance

Green run on an open PR; a deliberately failing test turns it red.
